title: Exceptional Hom transport through fully faithful comparison functors
statement:
Let $\mathcal X_e,\mathcal T_e,\mathcal X_p,\mathcal T_p$ be locally small categories [def-nagata-category]. Let $C_Z:\mathcal X_e\to\mathcal X_p$ and $C_T:\mathcal T_e\to\mathcal T_p$ be fully faithful functors, meaning that their maps on every Hom set are bijective. Suppose given adjunctions $C_T\dashv R$ and $F_e\dashv G_e$, where $F_e:\mathcal X_e\to\mathcal T_e$, and a functor $F_p:\mathcal X_p\to\mathcal T_p$ with a natural isomorphism $b:C_TF_e\xrightarrow{\sim}F_pC_Z$. An adjunction here is a natural Hom-set bijection, with its unit and counit given by the images of identity morphisms. Write $j:\mathrm{id}\to RC_T$ for the first unit, $\mu^e:F_eG_e\to\mathrm{id}$ for the second counit, and $G_p=C_ZG_eR$.
For $H\in\mathcal X_e$, $L\in\mathcal T_p$, define $h_{H,L}$ by the following specified composite, whose middle arrows are those of the given adjunctions:
$$\operatorname{Hom}(F_pC_ZH,L)\xrightarrow{(-)\circ b_H}\operatorname{Hom}(C_TF_eH,L)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(F_eH,RL)\cong\operatorname{Hom}(H,G_eRL)\xrightarrow{C_Z}\operatorname{Hom}(C_ZH,G_pL).$$
Then these are natural bijections. For every $N\in\mathcal T_e$, the map $o_N=C_ZG_e(j_N):C_ZG_eN\to G_pC_TN$ is invertible, and
$$h_{G_eN,C_TN}\bigl(C_T(\mu^e_N)\circ b_{G_eN}^{-1}\bigr)=o_N.$$
More precisely, composing $h_{H,C_TN}$ with postcomposition by $o_N^{-1}$ gives exactly the chain consisting of precomposition by $b_H$, the inverse of the fully faithful Hom map of $C_T$, the Hom bijection for $F_e\dashv G_e$, and the Hom map of $C_Z$. Thus the unique preimage of $o_N$ is $C_T(\mu^e_N)\circ b_{G_eN}^{-1}$; after identifying $G_pC_TN$ with $C_ZG_eN$ by $o_N$, this is the counit on these origin objects. This asserts only the displayed Hom bijections, not an adjunction on all objects of $\mathcal X_p$.
